items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: And Sidney Montague was on the drum. And then we had another city too. Sidney Fluency, guitar. That was there in the Deceyne, in the Sonny South band. We worked a while with that band.

ctx.x: So they went to Peel's band? Yeah, they went to Peel's band.

So what happened with Peter Bocas and them? Peter Bocas? He started his own band then. And we had the original Sonny South, you see. And then we had to get, I think, St. Johnson started playing with us then. And Sidney Montague was on the drum. And then we had another city too. Sidney Fluency, guitar. That was there in the Deceyne, in the Sonny South band. We worked a while with that band. And then that's where I started to play these clubs and band the Spanish. Then I started to stay in those spot jobs around…
Oh, by the way, before you get there, who was the leader of the Sonny South band? Bill Dejauw. Bill Dejauw.
